title: Common
description: Definitions shared by every Tilo contract. The root is a sampler with one optional property per definition so that fixtures and generated types cover each one; no service sends a Common document.

ulid.description: ULID in canonical upper-case Crockford base32 (26 characters).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with exactly three fractional digits, e.g. 2026-09-29T09:30:00.000Z.

credits.description: Tilo credits (PRD 14.1: 1 credit = US$0.005 at standard list prices).

risk_tier.description: Deterministic risk tier (PRD 10.4). T3 always needs a person.

autonomy_level.description: Autonomy level (PRD 10.4): L0 observe, L1 ask each time (default), L2 instruction is approval, L3 standing rules.

tool_access_level.description: Plain-language access level for one connector (FR-ACC-01, BQ-DSN-04, 1.5.0, ADR-0027): a ceiling on the risk tier an action of that connector may reach before the policy engine. off blocks every action, read allows reads only, draft allows reads and T1, act allows up to the policy engine's own ceiling (a T3 action still needs a person). It never authorises anything; a skill's level only lowers the team's (FR-ACC-02).

authz.description: Who authorised a side effect (BQ-01, ADR-0002): a person, a policy or a Team Lead, with the id of that authority and when. A model is never an authority. ref must match by: a user id for a person, a policy id for a policy, a Team Lead id for a Team Lead.

ref.description: Id of the authority: a user id for a person, a policy id, or a Team Lead id.

artifact_ref.description: A pinned version of a stored artifact.

destination.description: Where a side effect lands, by the connector's own opaque id: the thread a reply goes into (PRD 11.4, FR-CHN-13) or the folder a file is saved in, in the person's connected account. Letters, digits, underscore and hyphen only, so it is never a URL, a domain, an address or a path. Tilo does not parse it; the connector resolves it within the connection.

tier.description: World size by agent count (PRD 9.1): outpost 1-2, village 3-6, town 7-15, city 16+.

connector_id.description: Connector id as declared in config/connectors.yaml.

action_type.description: Side-effect or tool action type, e.g. send_email; the key of the risk-tier table.

plain_name.description: Display name of 2-24 plain characters (PRD 9.2): letters, digits, spaces and & ' . , ( ) / + -, starting with a letter or digit.

icon_name.description: Icon name from the published icon list (layout rule WE-08).

channel.description: Where a person sees and answers Tilo (PRD 10.3, 11.1), plus `schedule`, how a run that a recurring schedule started came to be (1.4.0, FR-AGT-14). `schedule` is not a place anyone answers: only world.requested uses it, and it is never an owner instruction or a person's approval (OB-01).

data_class.description: Data class (PRD 12.1): personal, business or public.

deliverable_format.description: Deliverable format (PRD 12.4), plus email for replies, in_app for answers shown in Tilo and, since 1.6.0 (ADR-0029), app: an AppSpec (appspec.schema.json) that fixed web code renders (FR-AGT-16).

media_type.description: Media type of a stored artifact version (ADR-0018). Text: Markdown and CSV; structured: JSON; files (made only by tilo-render or an intake upload, never by a model): PDF, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, PNG and JPEG, and since 1.7.0 (ADR-0034) WebM and MP4 video, which only a taught-skill capture upload stores (a screen recording or an uploaded example; never rendered or fetched). Code picks it, never a model: from the role and the pinned skill for a unit or render output, and from the file's own leading bytes for an upload (whose extension must agree) or a fetch (ADR-0029), never from a file name, a URL or a Content-Type header alone. Closed: no HTML or SVG.

credit_range.description: Estimated credits as a range; min <= max is checked by validators.

time_range.description: Estimated wall-clock seconds as a range; min_s <= max_s is checked by validators.

opaque_ref.description: An opaque reference to a record or a place in one (for example mt_x#ai3): letters, digits, underscore, hash and hyphen only, so no URL, domain, path or address fits (the destination rule).

maker.description: Who made a record: a person (ref is a user id) or Tilo (ref is an agent id, or system for the sweeper and syncs), and when. Provenance, not authority: a record Tilo made starts proposed and leaves that state only with a person's confirmed_by (PE-07, PE-08).

record_ref.description: A pointer to a record a claim rests on (assistant answers cite these, HR-1): its kind and id, never its content. For mail the id is the triage message id (1.3.0, ADR-0021); no kind names a transcript (ADR-0020).
